Ensure the final cell's citation supports its complete value under the output contract; never concatenate unrelated quotations and present them as one contiguous source span.

after.title: Recover evidence from partially failed fetch batches
after.body: When a fetch batch mixes usable text with failures, retain successful downloads by URL and track failures separately; exclude failure sentinels from extraction evidence. Inventory unresolved entity-field pairs after extracting and validating the usable evidence. For each remaining gap, inspect cached text first, then search for and fetch a relevant alternative source. Search snippets are leads, not substitutes for fetched proof. Do not repeat the entire successful portion of a batch or treat retrieval failure as evidence that a fact is absent. Validate the replacement quote against its fetched source and confirm that it supports the complete requested value before closing the gap. A failed URL need not eventually succeed when another verified source resolves the claim.

initial.body: PDF extraction can interleave columns and preserve long whitespace runs that model-generated quotations omit. Remove a mismatching citation only when the remaining citation independently supports the complete value. Recheck membership and semantic support after repair; substring membership alone does not establish semantic support. A proposed repair is not a verified repair.

initial.body: PDF extraction can interleave columns and preserve long whitespace runs that model-generated quotations omit. Remove a mismatching citation only when the remaining citation independently supports the complete value. Recheck membership and semantic support after repair; substring membership alone does not establish semantic support. A proposed repair is not a verified repair.
